title: Date and time

exercises.title: Build a UTC instant
exercises.description: Create **2024-01-01 12:00:00 UTC** and Console.WriteLine it exactly in the checker’s format.
hints: Construct `DateTimeOffset` with explicit `TimeSpan.Zero` offset for anchored UTC timestamps.
Format invariantly as `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` then suffix the literal ` UTC` token exactly.
Leverage `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture` for stable textual output.

exercises.title: Components in Tokyo
exercises.description: Build **2023-03-15 14:30** in **`Asia/Tokyo`** and Console.WriteLine the component lines expected by the checker.
exercises.expected_output:
Year: 2023
Month: March
Day: 15
Hour: 14
Minute: 30
Weekday: Wednesday
hints: Resolve canonical zones via `TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Asia/Tokyo")`.
`GetUtcOffset` feeds `DateTimeOffset` creation for wall-clock interpretation.
Month/weekday names come from invariant `MMMM`/`dddd` format patterns.

exercises.title: Durations
exercises.description: Print a C#-style duration line for **2h30m0s**, then Console.WriteLine **`500ms`** on the next line.
hints: Compose durations with `TimeSpan.FromHours` / `FromMinutes`.
Hours component often `(int)d.TotalHours` while minutes/seconds pull structural fields.
Second line literal matches fixed millisecond substring when specified.

exercises.title: Parse naive datetime
exercises.description: Parse `"2024-06-15 09:30:00"` as UTC wall time and Console.WriteLine `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss UTC`.
hints: `DateTimeOffset.ParseExact` honors custom patterns.
Combine `DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | AdjustToUniversal` when Wall time equals UTC labeling.

exercises.title: Format
hints: Separate short (`MM/dd/yyyy`) versus long textual formats explicitly.
Post-process duplicated spaces from ordinal day formatting replacements if graders expect single spacing.

exercises.title: Add duration
exercises.description: Start at **2024-01-15 10:00 UTC**, add **3 days + 5 hours**, Console.WriteLine the result in the same style as other UTC exercises.
hints: Add composite spans: `dto + TimeSpan.FromDays(...) + TimeSpan.FromHours(...)`.
Keep zero offsets whenever you append ` UTC` to timestamps.

exercises.title: Subtract instants
exercises.description: Between **2024-11-25** and **2024-12-25** UTC midnights, Console.WriteLine `720h0m0s` then `Days: 30`.
hints: Subtract two `DateTimeOffset` instances to derive `TimeSpan`.
Hours line often formats total whole hours (`(int)diff.TotalHours`).
Days line casts `TotalDays` to integers when fractions irrelevant.

exercises.title: Before / after
exercises.description: Compare two UTC instants and Console.WriteLine the two boolean lines expected by the checker.
exercises.expected_output:
January 1 is before December 31: true
December 31 is after January 1: true
hints: Comparison operators `<`/`>` communicate ordering compactly.
Lower-case booleans normally come from interpolating `.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()` results.

exercises.title: Fixed clock (no wall time)
exercises.description: Use a fixed `DateTimeOffset` (no `DateTime.Now`) and Console.WriteLine the instant, hour/minute, then **+1s** labeled like the checker.
hints: Never call ambient clocks—stay on constructed `DateTimeOffset` timelines.
`AddSeconds(1)` models incremental ticking explicitly.
Print hour/minute constituents before illustrating `+1s` shift.
